description: A warm, calm man in his forties with a gentle, resonant baritone voice. He is a native Greek speaker with a natural standard Athenian Greek accent. He prays aloud sincerely at a natural, unhurried conversational pace, with natural intonation, reverent but not slow and not theatrical.
ref_text: Δόξα Πατρί και Υιώ και Αγίω Πνεύματι, και νυν και αεί και εις τους αιώνας των αιώνων. Αμήν.
